summary: Updated ntfs-3g package fixes security vulnerabilities
details:
Heap buffer overflow in ntfs_acl_owner()
Heap buffer overflow in ntfs_same_sid()
Denial-of-service in ntfs_inode_attach_all_extents()
Heap buffer overflow in ntfs_check_restart_area()
Heap buffer overflow in ntfs_ea_check_wsldev()
Heap buffer overflow in ntfs_external_attr_find()
Heap data corruption in ntfs_mapping_pairs_decompress_i()
Heap out of bounds read/write in ntfs_ie_add_vcn()
